verdict.rationale: Marqeta's Core API docs describe webhooks as notifications about API events, sent as they occur to an endpoint hosted in your environment. That is a first-party, outbound HTTP callback mechanism a programmatic consumer can receive. The Gateway JIT funding flow, where Marqeta sends funding requests to your system, adds further evidence of outbound HTTP delivery. However, the pack contains only thin excerpts. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration/subscription API, event-type catalog and filtering, signature verification and retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
